Maria: Heads-up — Hydrangea just uploaded their LoRA adapter + int8 checkpoint to the onboarding bucket. quick sanity run shows a token-mapping skew for currency/amounts in a few prompts, tagging @Anika for tokenizer expertise.
Kevin: I can start a quick eval pack now, pinged the eval infra. should have first pass in ~10m.
Anika: thanks — I’ll pull the tokenizer vocab and diff it against our canonical mapping. any sample prompts that reproduce?
Maria: short repro in the bucket: s3://onboard/hydrangea/repro/amounts.json — examples like "Paid $1,200" -> tokenized into ["Paid", "$", "1", ",", "200"] instead of ["Paid", "$1,200"].
Kevin: running quick command now:
```
./run_quick_eval --model hydrangea-lora-int8 --prompts s3://onboard/hydrangea/repro/amounts.json --out /tmp/hydr_eval.json --batch 8 --quant int8
```
qa-bot: Quick eval job started (job_id=hj-3842). estimated runtime 7m.
Anika: pulled the vocab and tokenizer config — looks like they used a custom pre-tokenizer that treats "$" as separate. their tokenizer.json has "split_on_symbol": true.
Maria: ah ok. that explains it. do we want to patch their adapter to a canonical tokenizer mapping or add a token remap layer on the serving side?
Oliver: prefer a non-invasive remap for onboarding — add a small token alias table that rewrites sequences post-tokenize: e.g., ["$","1",",","200"] -> ["$1,200"]. cheaper than forcing them to regenerate adapters.
Anika: agree. I can prototype a remap patch: small python hook that runs after tokenization and before batching. sketch:
```
def remap_tokens(tok_seq):
    # detect $ + digits + optional comma groups -> join
    if tok_seq[0] == '$' and all(re.match(r"^[0-9,]+$", t) for t in tok_seq[1:3]):
        return ["$" + ''.join(tok_seq[1:3])] + tok_seq[3:]
    return tok_seq
```
Kevin: eval finished, attaching quick notes: /tmp/hydr_eval.json (summary) — baseline perplexity up 0.8 on amounts, but decoding outputs show token split errors as reported. after applying local remap patch, decoding matches expected formatting in 92% of samples.
Maria: cool. can you upload the patched eval and a small changelog to the onboarding folder? I’ll loop in the customer SEs with a repro and recommended fallback (remap + long-term suggestion: regenerate tokenizer).
Kevin: uploaded: s3://onboard/hydrangea/eval/1756789019-patch-report.json and patch script at s3://onboard/hydrangea/scripts/token_remap.py
Oliver: I’ll schedule a short canary in dev to route Hydrangea traffic through the remap layer for 24h and monitor token-level drift metrics. set a flag: hydrangea_remap=true in canary config.
Maria: thanks team. next steps: (1) prod canary with remap, (2) ask customer to consider tokenizer rebuild, (3) add a quick note into the onboarding checklist re: symbol-splitting tokenizers.
Anika: adding checklist entry now.
qa-bot: Job hj-3842 completed. artifacts uploaded.
Maria: done for now — will update after canary results. :thumbsup:
